title: Executive decision simulator & org stress-test playbook v0.1
notes_summary: Working playbook for running tabletop simulations during Q4 planning and the next all-hands. Contains three high-impact scenarios (demand shock, hiring pause, multi-region outage), decision matrices, suggested comms, and owner runbooks. Intentionally lightweight — used as facilitator script and exercise artifact.
body:
Purpose and scope:
- Build a repeatable, facilitation-friendly simulation for execs + leads to surface trade-offs across OKRs, headcount, budget, and SLAs.
- Primary audience: exec leadership, PMs, eng managers, finance and growth leads.
- Use in one-hour de-risking sessions ahead of all-hands or during quarterly planning.

How to run (facilitator script):
1) 5m — Set context: explain the goal (clarify primary company objective: protect product reliability while preserving runway and growth).
2) 10m — Present the baseline metrics and current OKR snapshot (see "baseline" below).
3) 30m — Run one scenario (pick the highest-likelihood scenario for this quarter). Walk through triggers, constraints, and decisions. Capture actions.
4) 10m — Rapid vote: RED/AMBER/GREEN on recommended action set. Record dissenting views.

Baseline (reference numbers — update from finance each week):
- ARR: $42.3M ARR (run-rate), growth MoM: 3.2%
- Cash runway: ~14 months at current burn
- Headcount: 152 FTE (engineering 82, product 18, GTM 28, ops/support 24)
- Avg latency p95 for hosted API: 180ms, error rate: 0.8%
- Production GPU capacity utilization (hosted fleet): 68%
- Dedicated contract pipeline: $1.8M ARR in negotiation
- Key OKR highlights (current quarter):
  * Improve per-token cost of hosted API by 15% (owner: infra)

SCENARIO A — Demand shock (50% spike in requests for 48 hours)
Trigger: Large partner integration goes viral or a partner runs an unexpected demo.
Immediate consequences:
- Fleet utilization -> 95%+. Latency p95 expected to climb to 350–600ms.
- Cost: Short-term cloud egress and burst GPUs add ~$120k over 48h if we scale naively.
- CS load: support tickets + 3x surge.
Decision owners: infra, platform-ops, growth, SRE
Points to consider (tradeoffs):
- Option 1: Auto-scale to absorb (pros: preserves SLA; cons: cost spike, risk of noisy neighbor)
- Option 2: Throttle by tier (pros: protects capacity for paid customers; cons: beginners hit free tier; PR risk)
- Option 3: Fallback to cheaper model variants for non-A customers (pros: cost control; cons: potential quality regressions, product regressions)
Recommended facilitator playbook:
- Triage in 15 minutes: identify impacted routes and top 10 customers by traffic.
- If projected cost > $60k over 24h, enact tiered-throttle policy (owner: platform-eng).
- Immediate comms: internal Slack #ops (template below), customer advisory to top 10 customers (CS lead).
- Postmortem: 72h timeline with quant metrics and rollback triggers.
Comms snippet (internal):
"We are currently experiencing a traffic spike affecting hosted API latency. Platform team running mitigations (tiered throttling, targeted autoscale). Prioritize paid customers and partners. Expect updates every 30m."

SCENARIO B — Hiring pause / budget rebaseline (3 month hiring freeze)
Trigger: Board asks to compress hiring for runway protection or market contraction.
Immediate consequences:
- Hiring freeze impacts 12 open reqs (priority: infra, SRE, growth).
- Reallocation pressure: product roadmaps must defer to reliability and churn reduction work.
Decision owners: CEO, CFO, Head of Eng, Head of Product
Options and tradeoffs:
- Option 1: Prioritize critical hires only (requires exec approval per req).
- Option 2: Reprioritize spend: move contract dollars to critical infra, pause non-critical pilots.
- Option 3: Voluntary 6-month deferral program for offers nearing start date (pros: preserves candidates; cons: candidate dropoff risk).
Operational checklist if freeze enacted:
- Freeze standup template to notify hiring managers and recruiters (owner: people ops).
- Roadmap triage: 2-week audit to mark features that can be delayed with minimal customer impact (owner: product ops).
- OKR impact: mark objectives that depend on hiring as "at risk"; scale down targets and capture dependency notes.
Comms snippet (external to be used at all-hands):
"We are taking a pause on most hiring to extend runway and focus on reliability and customer retention. We remain committed to strategic hires that materially impact SLAs or revenue."

SCENARIO C — Multi-region outage affecting dedicated and hosted (6 hours)
Trigger: Cloud provider partial outage or major networking incident in a primary region.
Immediate consequences:
- Some Dedicated customers report degraded performance, and hosted API has elevated error rates.
- Replica failover might not be instantaneous due to warm caches and GPU state.
Decision owners: SRE, infra, support leads, success leads
Playbook snippets:
- Runbook step 0: Declare incident and open incident channel; notify execs.
- Telemetry: switch to degraded-mode dashboard (reduced metrics, focus on top routes).
- Capacity moves: shift burst traffic to secondary region where possible; if cold-cache penalty > 30% p95, consider controlled rollback of last deploy.
- Customer comms: proactive status page updates and targeted outreach to affected dedicated accounts.
Post-incident: 7-day deep dive required for delegated RCA.

Decision matrix (example)
- Dimensions: short-term cost, SLA impact, brand risk, operational complexity, reversible quickly
- Scoring guidance: 1 (low)–5 (high). Use for 3 candidate actions per scenario and sum to guide recommendation. (Facilitator has matrix template in Confluence link.)

Action capture template (use verbatim during session)
- Decision ID: auto-generated at time of capture
- Scenario: (A|B|C)
- Action summary: short sentence
- Owner: name + backup
- Estimated effort (S/M/L)
- Expected impact on OKRs (which objective, quantitative delta)
- Communication required (internal/external)
- Rollback criteria
- Follow-up date

Voting rubric (fast consensus):
- GREEN: go (>= 70% support)
- AMBER: partial go / pilot (40–69%)
- RED: do not proceed (< 40%)

Unresolved questions / to validate before all-hands:
- Update runway with latest revenue recognition from new Dedicated contracts (finance to confirm).
- Confirm contract language for tiered throttling with legal for enterprise customers.
- Validate customer-impact thresholds for auto-fallback to cheaper models (research applied-ml).

Appendix: quick links and templates
- Incident comms template: confluence:CI-ORG/incident-templates
- Roadmap triage spreadsheet (sheet): drive:roadmap-triage-oct25
- Hiring freeze notification template: drive:people/hiring-freeze-template

Notes-to-self (facilitator):
- Keep colors simple in vote — don't let conversation drift into feature-level discussions.
- Call for a 15m follow-up sync if any decision captures > $50k cost or >2 FTE impact.
- For all-hands: run a 10m micro-sim (pick a lightweight scenario) and surface 3 concrete asks to the org.

Version history:
- v0.1 (this doc): initial facilitation flow and 3 canonical scenarios for Q4 planning.

Open action items (owner: Ava Chen):
- Pull latest deployment latency stats and attach before next exec sim (due: 2025-10-20).
- Confirm Confluence template link and attach decision matrix file (due: 2025-10-22).
- Schedule dry run with CEO + SRE lead (target: 2025-10-28).

End of doc.
